usedFor: Zoho Sign tracks documents for signature, and Keka adds the person through “Add an new employee” after a recipient signs.

bestTemplate.name: “When a document is fully signed and approved by all recipients” in Zoho Sign, then “Add an new employee” in Keka
bestTemplate.why: Keka creates the employee with personal details, job assignment and salary information once every recipient has signed.

watchOut: “When a recipient signs a document” fires for any recipient, so “Add an new employee” can run too early.
